caption: The worked example in one pass down the stack: 1200 bytes of data go down and each layer adds its own header, so the frame on the wire is 1258 bytes, 58 bytes of it overhead, for 95.39 percent efficiency.

nodes.label: 2 Data link +18 B
nodes.note: hdr 14 B, trailer 4 B; frame = 1258 bytes

spec.aria: Data of 1200 bytes passing down the OSI stack: transport adds 20 bytes making a 1220-byte segment, network adds 20 bytes making a 1240-byte packet, data link adds 14 bytes of header and a 4-byte trailer making a 1258-byte frame, which is 58 bytes of overhead and 95.39 percent efficiency.
